svg.title: The Leverage Loop — Five Steps
svg.desc: Vertical five-card diagram: 1 Capture, 2 Structure, 3 Judgment (highlighted as the key human step), 4 Re-run, 5 Repeat. Each card has one line describing the step. Repeat until your stop condition passes.
